rows.en: Celica: "H-Have we made contact?!"
Ymir: "Well..."
Miyasco: "Oh..."
Ymir: "The facility... It's on fire..."
Celica: "No..."
Sisk: "Y-Your Highness!"
Lodis: "Cough, cough... H-Hello..."
Sisk: "Your Highness! Your Highness!"
Lodis: "We had a little trouble, but we're all right here.
Everyone's safe, and we secured the evidence too."
Celica: "...Thank goodness."
Lodis: "But a researcher who'd lost all hope
set off an explosion. Everything's ablaze.
We'd appreciate it if you could come rescue us..."
Celica: "What?! Honestly! This isn't the time
to be so casual about it!
Wait there. We're coming right away!"
Lodis: "Yes. I'll send our coordinates now.
...I'm counting on you, then."
Lodis: "...Phew. That's one worry out of the way."
Rest: "That was a close call indeed."
Derock: "It certainly was.
We nearly got roasted alive."
Celica: "Brother! Everyone!"
Lodis: "We're back."
Yamato: "...Anyway, I'm glad you're all safe."
Touya: "Yeah. But how did they find out what we were doing?"
Rest: "They hadn't. There was no sign of that
when we infiltrated the facility."
Ai: "Then why did those creepy Armored Mechs
come after us?"
Lodis: "Apparently, they were running an exercise
to collect experimental data. They happened to encounter Liebhofen
during it."
Touya: "Then when they ran into us,
that information must've reached the facility too, right?
You hadn't already taken the place by then, had you?
Isn't that a little too fast?
It hadn't been that long since you left..."
Lodis: "We tampered with their communications facilities.
It was Derock's idea."
Derock: "Heh. It's a basic part of infiltration.
Cutting them off completely would raise suspicion, so
we only stopped information from outside getting through."
Ai: "Huh..."
Lodis: "Then we went farther inside and photographed the research evidence,
took some objects as evidence, and erased the data...
They seemed to rely on their security systems,
so once those were disabled, it was fairly easy."
Kasumi: "Amazing! It's like a spy movie."
Lodis: "Ha ha ha ha! It wasn't anything that impressive.
Well, that part went well, but a researcher
discovered us. We'd almost finished
our work and didn't want any needless fighting,
so I told him to give up. That had the opposite effect.
Perhaps he was terrified of being held responsible.
The man became hysterical and sent the reactor out of control,
trying to blow up the facility, with us inside.
We somehow stopped the runaway reaction, but unfortunately,
some chemicals reacted with each other and started a fire...
After that, we contacted you, and you rescued us.
That's what happened."
Celica: "Honestly... Take a little better care of yourself!
It's just selfish not to think about
the people who worry about you, you know?"
Lodis: "...You're right. People who worry about me...
I'm sorry, Celica. Everyone..."
Sisk: "Your Highness!"
Lodis: "Whoa! S-Sisk, stop that..."
Sisk: "Honestly! I was so worried about you!
Does anything hurt? You're not injured, are you?
Oh, look at you, all covered in soot..."
Lodis: "H-Hey..."
Sisk: "........Thank goodness..."
Lodis: "Huh?"
Sisk: "...I'm glad you're safe...
You and everyone else, Your Highness..."
Lodis: "...Yes."
Celica: "...Well. We've more or less finished putting out the fire,
so shall we take the evidence and return to Shangria?"
Ymir: "Yes. There's no need to linger in Zigrim territory
and provoke them."
Miyasco: "..."
Sisk: "Y-You're right! Let's hurry!"
Miyasco: "...Please wait.
There's something I must tell everyone."
Sisk: "Miyasco..."
Celica: "...Are you sure?"
Miyasco: "Yes. I'll tell you everything.
About that insane project, 'Code 3'..."
Miyasco: "...The human enhancement project, commonly called 'Code 3.'
The plan was for humans created through genetic engineering
to be further enhanced artificially with drugs, so that perfect soldiers
could be created.
I too was born and raised in a research institute..."
Sisk: "What?!"
Rest: "Miyasco..."
Miyasco: "That inhumane project, with its complete disregard for ethics,
was immediately halted by the previous president
and scrapped.
The immediate cause was test subjects going berserk. Just five of them
wiped out two battalions.
But all records of these events were secretly erased,
and everything was buried in the shadows of history..."
Rest: "At the time, I was on border patrol duty,
and I fought those berserk subjects.
She was one of those five."
Miyasco: "Thanks to Major Rest's kindness, the Kingdom of Agarthia
took me in, and I finally reached the point
where I could live an ordinary life."
Celica: "But I never heard any report about that.
Neither did you, right, Brother?"
Lodis: "Not until recently. But Rest made the right decision.
If people had learned about you, even in Agarthia,
someone would have tried to use you."
Celica: "...That could happen.
Hmm? But didn't Zigrim try to silence you
in some way?"
Miyasco: "No. In exchange for my safety, Major Rest
swore an Oath of the Sword to keep the secret.
He did that for someone like me..."
Fain: "An oath?! You swore a knight's most
sacred vow, the 'Oath of the Sword,'
to the people responsible for all that evil?!"
Rest: "A knight's pride and a woman's future...
There's no need even to weigh them against each other."
Fain: "Oh! So this is what it means to have your eyes opened!
As expected of my master! I'm truly impressed!
Uoooooh! You're so cool! Ghh!"
Celica: "...Let's leave him to it and get back to the story.
So President Horem restarted that project?
But in the last battle, ordinary soldiers suddenly
transformed, didn't they? What does that mean?"
Rest: "According to First Lieutenant Reamond Dalaim,
rather than creating people from scratch this time,
they're using drugs to force them to obey temporarily."
Ymir: "Drugs... Doing that would cause serious damage
to both their nerves and their minds!"
Ai: "...That's the lowest, most despicable method imaginable."
Miyasco: "...I'm sorry I kept quiet all this time.
The truth is, I was afraid...
Afraid I'd have to leave you all if the truth came out..."
Sisk: "I see... Now I understand
why you've been acting so strangely."
Miyasco: "...I'm sorry, Sisk."
Sisk: "It's okay. However you came into this world, Miyasco,
you're still Miyasco.
We're still friends. That won't change."
Miyasco: "Sisk..."
Sisk: "I told you, didn't I?
'True friends never betray each other.'"
Miyasco: "Sisk... Thank you..."
Lodis: "Miyasco... Thank you for telling us.
Rest's decision was right.
You've suffered all this time, and from now on too..."
Miyasco: "No. I have companions I can rely on,
and a true friend."
Lodis: "Heh heh... So you do."
Arthur: "...Wait a moment.
Prince Cain was there, wasn't he? That means
he's reported it to President Horem..."
Xiujian: "...It's easy to predict that Growster
will turn back..."
Clovis: "...An ambush, huh."
Aurelie: "Wouldn't it be bad if they used that drug
on the soldiers stationed in the capital?"
Celica: "It's probably still in development, so they couldn't
use it on a large scale. But it seems we can't just sit back
and wait to see what they do."
Lodis: "I'm concerned about ≪Ze=Ode≫ too,
but this is more urgent. If that project gets fully underway,
we'll be drawn into a pointless war of attrition."
Rest: "If the project is put into action, Zigrim will unite the continent...
No, the world.
But all that will remain will be fields burned by war
and people's profound sorrow."
Ymir: "But now that they've refused our cooperation, if we head
for the capital..."
Sisk: "Huh? What's this?!
Someone's breaking into our Class One circuit!"
Reamond: "...I apologize for this sudden breach of courtesy.
But we've reached a point where we can no longer
worry about appearances."
Lodis: "What happened?"
Reamond: "...We were defeated."
Touya: "What?!"
Ai: "...Seriously?"
Reamond: "Only I and
Lieutenant Colonel Fores Mishual escaped the battle.
And the colonel is wounded and unconscious..."
Lodis: "What happened to General Growster?
Surely he wasn't... Killed in action...?"
Reamond: "I don't know. But because His Excellency stayed behind in Baresios,
we were able to escape...
At this rate, the president will have his way.
I know it's selfish of me to ask, but please help us.
This concerns the future of Zigrim... No, the world.
I promise I'll prove your innocence."
Celica: "Help you do what, exactly?"
Reamond: "Assault the presidential residence."
Clovis: "...That's a bold request."
Reamond: "I'm well aware of that.
But it's the only option we have left.
Fortunately, it's some distance from the city."
Captain Roa: "Hmm!"
Ymir: "!? B-But...
...Understood. We certainly have no time to hesitate.
Is that acceptable to you too, Your Majesty?"
Lodis: "You needn't ask. As the Kingdom of Agarthia's
king, I accept First Lieutenant Reamond Dalaim's
request. Is that all right with you too, Rest?"
Rest: "Yes, Your Majesty. As you wish..."
Celica: "All right. We'll head there directly, then.
Is that okay?"
Reamond: "Yes. I'll head there as soon as I'm ready too.
While you're subduing the defenders, I'll slip into the residence
and take the president into custody."
Touya: "So we'll be the decoys outside, huh?
But the timing's going to be tricky, right?
How will we handle that?"
Reamond: "I'll send over my plan later.
I'll also signal you before I begin,
so I'd like you to start moving after that."
Touya: "That's fine, but..."
Lodis: "Will you be all right alone?"
Reamond: "Yes. I was made for that sort of thing too.
...Now, if you'll excuse me."
Ai: "Made...?"
Miyasco: "Like me, he was a 'test subject.'
And to stop 'Code 3,'
he intends to stake everything."
Ai: "Let's go! Let's go slap the bastard
who came up with this idiotic plan across the face!"
Celica: "Yes. For now, let's hurry and organize the data!
Touya, you and the others should rest while we do that."
Touya: "Huh? But..."
Arthur: "Resting is part of a pilot's job too."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... You're right. All right."
Rest: "Then I'll help with Zaxas's maintenance.
Even our excellent mechanics may have trouble
with a mech they've never worked on before."
Celica: "Really? That'll help.
Oh, but shouldn't you see her before that?"
Rest: "Maki? Thank you for your consideration.
But right now, some things must take priority over personal feelings."
Celica: "...Really?"
Rest: "...If you'll excuse me."
Miyasco: "Oh..."
Miyasco: "Major Rest!"
Rest: "...What is it?"
Miyasco: "Um... Aren't you going to see Maki?"
Rest: "Heh. She's not that fragile."
Miyasco: "That's not true. Maki is..."
Rest: "Miyasco. You needn't worry.
Maki is a strong woman. Stronger than we think."
Miyasco: "!!"
Rest: "Miyasco..."
Miyasco: "You don't understand anything!
Do you really love Maki?!
Maki loves you with all her heart!
So deeply... I could never compete..."
Rest: "...What happened?
I heard Maki's injuries weren't serious..."
Miyasco: "Not Maki's own injuries.
But the new life, and her heart..."
Rest: "D-Don't tell me..."
Miyasco: "Maki needs you now.
Please be there for Maki...
Maki is in the infirmary."
Rest: "I understand. I'm sorry!"
Miyasco: "Maki... I hope you'll be happy..."
Rest: "Maki!"
Maki: "Oh... R-Rest!
A-At least knock before you come in..."
Rest: "Maki..."
Maki: "Oh, don't look like that.
You're ruining that handsome face."
Rest: "...I'm sorry."
Maki: "There you go again, always trying to take the blame...
I didn't help because you asked me to.
I helped because I wanted to.
They really were fighting for this world."
Rest: "..."
Maki: "Still, not coming to rescue me when I'm in trouble
might disqualify you as a boyfriend. What if I ended up scarred
and couldn't get married? What would you do?"
Rest: "...Then I'd take responsibility."
Maki: "There you go again..."
Rest: "..."
Maki: "Huh...? Are you serious?"
Rest: "Am I not good enough for you after all?"
Maki: "N-No! That's not it!
I'm happy..."
Rest: "Maki..."
Maki: "Rest... There's something I have to
tell you..."
Rest: "...I know.
Miyasco told me. You've been through so much..."
Maki: "...Yeah... I was so sad...
I cried so much, I thought something was wrong with me...
I... Wanted to be a mother..."
Rest: "..."
Maki: "Heh heh... That hurts..."
Rest: "Maki..."
Maki: "...I have to live...
I have to live a full life for that child too...
...Right? Rest...?"
Rest: "Yes..."
Tix: "...Huh? Why am I here...?
Beyond here is the Chamber of Sealing... The place that protects the 'Guardian'..."
Tix: "...What is this? It feels familiar...
But a little different too..."
Tix: "Is that... An Armored Mech...?
No, it's something else..."
Tix: "!! ...Wh-Who's there?!"
?????: "...Hello. It's been a while, Tix."
Tix: "I-It can't be... Big Brother Rayfon?"
